title: FairCLIP: Harnessing Fairness in Vision-Language Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (AUC, ES-AUC) and fairness metrics (Demographic Parity Difference, Difference in Equalized Odds) for glaucoma diagnosis across Asian, Black, and White patient subgroups using linear probing and zero-shot transfer.

Evaluating model performance (AUC, ES-AUC) and fairness metrics (Demographic Parity Difference, Difference in Equalized Odds) for glaucoma diagnosis across Female and Male patient subgroups using linear probing and zero-shot transfer.

Evaluating model performance (AUC, ES-AUC) and fairness metrics (Demographic Parity Difference, Difference in Equalized Odds) for glaucoma diagnosis across Non-Hispanic and Hispanic patient subgroups using linear probing and zero-shot transfer.

Evaluating model performance (AUC, ES-AUC) and fairness metrics (Demographic Parity Difference, Difference in Equalized Odds) for glaucoma diagnosis across patient subgroups based on preferred language (English, Spanish, Others) using linear probing and zero-shot transfer.
